WHAT: iOS Swift app for practicing negotiation techniques through isolated drills and full roleplay scenarios. Duolingo for negotiation.

TWO MODES:
1. Drill Mode — show conversation snippet, identify which technique to apply (label/mirror/reflect). Quick isolated reps, scored, progressive difficulty. The key differentiator from 'just chatting with ChatGPT.'
2. Scenario Mode — full conversation with AI playing the other side (salary negotiation, difficult client, conflict resolution). Scored on technique usage and execution.

TECHNIQUE TREE:
- Chris Voss: labeling, mirroring, tactical empathy, no-oriented questions, accusation audit, calibrated questions
- Motivational Interviewing: reflective listening, double-sided reflections, developing discrepancy, eliciting change talk, OARS
- Cialdini/Influence: reciprocity, commitment/consistency, social proof, authority, liking, scarcity

STATUS: Designed, not built. Ned confirmed he'd ship it: 'it's a cool fucking thing.'

BLOCKER: Same initiation issue as all current projects — knows what to do, can't start without dopamine.

NOTE: Ned previously tested this concept with raw system prompts — worked but wasn't structured as a product.
